text_block_list.text:
On the way back from going out with Fuji 
Kiseki――

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to thank you for coming to the 
exhibition with me the other day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"So... this event on the desk in the 
trainer's office, how about we go check it 
out now?"

The flyer Fuji Kiseki showed me was... for 
an interactive event at the shopping mall 
that was supposed to be left in the 
Trainer's office.

"If you can escape from cast members 
acting as zombies until the time limit 
expires, you win a prize."

There was a state-of-the-art pair of shoes 
for Umamusume on the prize list, and while 
I was eyeing it with interest—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's go together if you'd like. See, I'm 
pretty confident when it comes to running!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you the ultimate victory as a 
present!

And so, I ended up joining an interactive 
event on short notice together with Fuji 
Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
No breaking the law or doing anything 
extreme! That said, let's enjoy ourselves 
to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text: And now, here we go~!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOH~~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's some amazing special effects 
makeup—I mean, those zombies have 
terrifying faces!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's so fast... Were the cast 
members— I mean, in their past lives, were 
they Umamusume?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's heading over here! Let's move 
quietly...!

text_block_list.name: Male Participant
text_block_list.text:
Stop, stay back...! There's only 10 
minutes left... GYAAAAHH--!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Kuh. They got her too...!

text_block_list.name: Female Participant
text_block_list.text:
"A huge horde is coming from over there! 
Everyone, run!"

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOH~~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Bad news, we gotta get away! Trainer, 
this way!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *Haa, fuu*... Are you alright, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This place is... um, I can see the 1st 
floor through the open atrium, so the 2nd 
floor, maybe? Somewhere to hide is—

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOH~~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! It's here! Let's head over there, 
quick!

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOH~~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wait, a pincer attack?! This is bad...!

Several people are coming from both sides. 
If it were just Fuji Kiseki alone, maybe, 
but breaking through with two of us seems 
tough!

I racked my brain for a good way to handle 
this. A way for Fuji Kiseki to claim 
victory safely—
choice_data_list:
Hold Fuji Kiseki and jump down to the 
first floor

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh, jump down!?

text_block_list.name: Zombies
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOH~~!

"The zombies were already right on top of 
us. There was no time to explain or 
convince her. In an instant, I scooped 
Fuji Kiseki into my arms and—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: T-Traaaainer!?
Leapt down to the first floor.

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That was a dramatic getaway! And you 
protected your companion without a single 
scratch!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
"However, extreme behavior is strictly 
forbidden! Therefore, unfortunately, you 
are disqualified!"

And so... the event ended without us 
winning any prizes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Here, stick your ankle out! I'm gonna put 
a compress on it. It might be a little 
cold, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You really startled me. If you had at 
least talked to me, I could have—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. You carried me down so that my 
leg wouldn't hurt, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why... I was thinking it 
was rather pushy of you, considering.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......Good grief. You really are quite the 
handful of a Trainer.

Fuji Kiseki's expression was gentle as she 
said that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, while I often protect 
others, having someone protect me... 
doesn't really happen much."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even if it did, I'd usually feel bad about 
it. But—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, somehow... in some way, you might 
just be different from everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I'm just genuinely happy. 
So... thank you, Trainer."

With that said, Fuji Kiseki steps closer 
to me—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that's beside the point! Since 
you hurt your foot, your punishment is a 
piggyback ride home!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't get down! This is your 
punishment for being reckless.

In the twilight, Fuji Kiseki carried me on 
her back as we headed home in high 
spirits.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wait, a decoy!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you can't! I could never let you 
do that! I would much rather do it myself—
choice_data_list:
If it's just you, you're sure to shake 
them off and stay in front!

If it's just you alone, you'll definitely 
break away to victory!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
choice_data_list:
That's why I want you to come back with a 
win, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I swear I will bring victory 
back to you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Captured Female Participant A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that last girl is being chased by all 
the zombies... Wait, huh!? Isn't that Fuji 
Kiseki!?

text_block_list.name: Captured Female Participant B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? For real!? It is!! Whoa! She might 
actually pull off a runaway win, can't 
she!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaah!!

"—Afterward, Fuji Kiseki fought her way 
through a horde of zombies and claimed a 
glorious victory!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*, thank goodness! Those zombie girls 
were so fast, that was close.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... it's actually thanks to 
you. You cast a spell on me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You can definitely pull off the runaway 
win." Didn't you say that to me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You told me that if it was me, I could 
definitely hold the lead, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And that's when I thought, I have to lead 
all the way to the end. If they believe in 
me this much.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Your words have the power to cast a 
spell on me, don't they!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And it turned out to be even stronger than 
expected! This is an incredible weapon, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With that magic, and just a single word of 
encouragement from you, I feel like I 
could run forever.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was a really fun event! Let's 
go together again sometime, Trainer.

And so, while making promises for our next 
outing, the two of us leisurely headed 
back home.
